candidates.name: Anterior Interosseous Syndrome
support_spans: episodes of isolated, sudden weakness of the left upper limb
weakness of the distal phalanx of the thumb and middle phalanx of the index finger
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and electromyographic evaluation suggest a condition affecting the anterior interosseous nerve.

candidates.name: Mononeuritis Multiplex
support_spans: neurogenic atrophy of muscles innervated by the anterior interosseous nerve
changes in the biceps brachii, triceps brachii, and deltoid muscles
candidates.why: The involvement of multiple nerves in the upper limb suggests a condition like mononeuritis multiplex.

candidates.name: Multifocal Motor Neuropathy

candidates.name: Neuralgic Amyotrophy

no sensory deficits

candidates.name: Plexus Injury

candidates.why: A normal MRI suggests that the condition may not be related to a structural abnormality, but rather a plexus injury.
